The GL Manager is a hands-on people leader who owns payroll accounting, prepares equity rollforwards, oversees accounts payable (coding and payouts), and performs monthly flux/variance analysis (including COGS vs. SG&A classification review), while also serving as the reviewer of all work performed by the Senior GL Accountants and, by extension, the GL Accountants who report into them. This role manages a team of three -five (two Senior GL Accountants, an AP Specialist, and the GL Accountants) and is accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and audit-readiness of the general ledger areas owned by the team. The general ledger areas owned by the team include, but are not limited to: bank transaction coding/uploading, cash reconciliations, prepaid expenses, fixed assets (including capitalized software) leases, accrued expenses, accounts payable, expense reports & corporate credit cards, and payout expenses and returns and intercompany clearing.

This is a leadership role that combines direct ownership of several close areas with day-to-day coaching, review, and prioritization of the broader accounting team's work. As Topstep's finance organization continues to mature, the specific accounts and processes owned by this role may shift; the GL Manager is expected to flex into new areas (e.g., intercompany, cash/bank accounting, leases, or other balance sheet areas) as priorities evolve and to help define ownership as the team scales.

Key Responsibilities

• Leadership & Team Management

• Directly manage and develop the two Senior GL Accountants and the AP Specialist, including workload prioritization, coaching, and performance management.

• Provide second-level review and sign-off on work performed by the GL Accountant(s) who report into the Senior GL Accountants, ensuring consistency and quality across the full team.

• Set daily and monthly priorities for the team in line with the month-end close calendar established with the Assistant Controller and Controller.

• Identify staffing, training, and process gaps within the team and recommend solutions to the Assistant Controller.

• Hold the team accountable for timely, accurate, and well-documented deliverables; escalate risks or resourcing constraints proactively.

• Payroll Accounting

• Own execution of all payroll-related journal entries, including regular payroll, subsidiary expense allocations, fringe benefits, and management fee allocations.

• Partner with People/HR and Payroll on GL mapping, coding of new departments/entities, and resolution of payroll data discrepancies.

• Reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts (e.g., accrued payroll, payroll clearing, benefits) on a monthly basis.

• Maintain and continuously improve payroll accounting SOPs, including CSV upload templates for payroll, accruals, and subsidiary expense allocations.

• Accounts Payable Oversight (Coding & Payouts)

• Oversee AP coding accuracy across vendors, departments, and entities, including review of the AP Specialist's day-to-day coding.

• Provide guidance and approver training so that vendor coding is applied consistently and correctly at the point of entry.

• Oversee payout-related AP activity in partnership with the Senior GL Accountants, including bill creation, payout returns, and related AP reconciliations.

• Review and approve AP aging, prepared by the Senior GL Accountant, on a recurring basis and ensure aging ties to the trial balance; drive resolution of long-outstanding items.

• Monthly Flux / Variance Analysis

• Perform monthly period-over-period (and budget-to-actual, as applicable) flux analysis for accounts owned by the team, including payroll, AP-driven expense accounts, and COGS/SG&A lines.

• Investigate and document explanations for significant fluctuations; distinguish true business drivers from coding or classification issues.

• As part of this analysis, review COGS vs. SG&A classification across the chart of accounts to ensure new vendors, expense types, and cost-sharing arrangements are mapped and coded appropriately.

• Summarize flux commentary for the Assistant Controller and Controller ahead of monthly and quarterly reporting deadlines.

• Equity Accounting

• Prepare and maintain monthly equity rollforward schedules for Topstep LLC and applicable subsidiaries, capturing contributions, distributions, in-kind transfers, and net income allocations.

• Ensure equity rollforwards tie to the trial balance each month and are supported by underlying agreements, board/member approvals, and intercompany documentation.

• Partner with Legal, Tax, and outside advisors on the treatment of in-kind contributions, intercompany transfers, and entity restructurings impacting equity.

• Provide a quarterly summary of equity activity to the Assistant Controller and Controller for review.

• Review of GL Team’s Work & Balance Sheet Ownership

• Review and approve balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting schedules prepared by the Senior GL Accountants prior to Assistant Controller review. This may include review of bank transaction coding/uploading, cash reconciliations, prepaid expenses, fixed assets (including capitalized software), leases, accrued expenses, accounts payable, expense reports & corporate credit cards, and payout expenses and returns and intercompany clearing.

• Ensure every account owned by the team has a clearly identified preparer/reviewer, a documented process, and audit-ready support.

• Resolve or escalate aged and complex reconciling items surfaced by the team.

• Audit & Compliance

• Prepare and/or review audit schedules and support requests related to owned general ledger areas, as requested by the Assistant Controller and Controller.

• Maintain documentation standards that are audit-ready at all times across the team's owned areas.

• Adhere to internal controls and company accounting policies; identify and flag control gaps to management.

• Process Improvement & Systems

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and consistency across owned close areas and the broader team's workflow.

• Leverage NetSuite and related tools (e.g., CSV import templates, reconciliation tools) effectively; support system improvements as directed by the Assistant Controller and Controller.

• Partner with cross-functional teams (People/HR, FP&A, Treasury, Product/Engineering) to ensure payroll, AP, and other data flows accurately into the general ledger.

Required Qualifications and Key Competencies

• Effective communicator with the ability to coach staff and work cross-functionally.

Company Culture & Perks

New Hire Base Salary Range

As OKX US continues to grow, we are looking for a Support Operations Lead to join our Business Management team, with a focus on leading and coaching our global Customer Support (CS) function to better serve OKX users. Rather than being a direct member of the CS team, you’ll work alongside Operations, Compliance, Product, and Marketing stakeholders to uplift the quality, efficiency, and regulatory compliance of our offshore CS agents.

You’ll act as a subject matter expert (SME) for all things within the customer support experience — helping offshore agents understand local customer expectations, regulations, and how to handle issues with care and accuracy. This is a strategic and high-impact role, laying the groundwork for improved CS experience and potentially a local team in the future.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Represent the voice of the customer within the business and act as SME for support needs, regulations, and expectations.

•

Coach and guide offshore CS teams to improve handling of tickets, especially regulatory-sensitive cases (e.g., scam/fraud, ID verification).

•

Partner with local Compliance, Operations, and Legal to ensure offshore CS agents are trained and updated on local regulatory requirements.

•

Manage high-priority and escalated customer cases in collaboration with offshore agents and local teams.

•

Liaise with Customer Due Diligence (CDD) teams to improve KYC/AML workflows for customers and reduce customer friction.

•

Act as SME for OKX Card support operations — guiding offshore CS on dispute handling, chargeback processes, and cardholder issue resolution in line with card program compliance requirements.

•

Work closely with Product and Marketing teams to proactively inform CS of upcoming campaigns, changes, or product launches that may drive ticket volume.

•

Identify operational pain points in the customer journey and work cross-functionally to resolve or escalate them.

•

Develop SOPs, quick guides, and training materials to help offshore agents respond more effectively to users.

•

Track key CS metrics such as resolution time, CSAT, and escalation volume to measure success and identify improvement areas.

•

If the business moves toward a local CS team in the future, help scope, plan, and build this function from the ground up.

What We Look For In You

Experience & Industry Knowledge

•

5+ years of experience in customer operations, customer experience, or support leadership, ideally within fintech, crypto, or financial services.

•

Solid understanding of US financial regulation, consumer protection expectations, and AML/KYC processes.

•

Experience working with or leading offshore support teams in a high-growth or regulated environment.

•

Exposure to customer-centric operations functions — blending support, risk, compliance, and product feedback loops.

Skills & Competencies

•

Strong leadership and coaching ability, with a focus on raising offshore team performance without direct line management.

•

Excellent stakeholder management skills — ability to work across compliance, product, marketing, and support teams.

•

Operationally minded — you're a problem-solver who can turn user pain points into action plans.

•

Process-driven — capable of designing and implementing SOPs and knowledge base content.

•

Excellent communicator — able to distill regulatory complexity into practical CS guidance.

Analytical — confident using data and KPIs to improve customer outcomes and support operations.

The High Risk Trader Onboarding Analyst is an operational investigator within the Onboarding & Identity Operations team, responsible for reviewing elevated-risk Identity Verification (IDV) exceptions, performing Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and conducting thorough financial crime screenings across global trader accounts.

Serving as the primary operational intake for elevated risk profiles, this role investigates Tier-2 escalations from front-line onboarding teams that exceed standard verification logic, such as suspected synthetic identity indicators, document tampering, multi-jurisdictional tax discrepancies (W-8/W-9), and potential sanctions hits. Operating within established operating frameworks and investigative templates, you will clear routine screening alerts, assemble structured case packages for Enforcement review, and escalate novel fraud vectors or complex corporate entities to Senior High Risk Analysts.

Key Responsibilities

• IDV & CIP Escalation Review: Review and disposition Tier-2 identity verification escalations referred by front-line onboarding analysts. Investigate flagged accounts exhibiting synthetic identity traits, digital document manipulation, device/IP anomalies, or unverified registration data against established risk rubrics.

• Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) Execution: Perform structured EDD investigations on elevated-risk traders. Collect, review, and evaluate baseline financial documentation to verify identity legitimacy and account eligibility.

• Investigative Case Packaging: Compile clear, evidence-based case files summarizing identity telemetry, document discrepancies, and risk rationales. Submit structured findings to Senior Analysts, Compliance, and Enforcement teams for account restrictions, suspensions, or closure.

• Triage & Senior Escalation: Identify high-complexity scenarios, such as organized multi-account fraud rings, highly layered entity structures, or emergent attack vectors, and route them with complete preliminary findings to the Senior High Risk Trader Onboarding Analyst.

• Audit Trail & Record Governance: Maintain precise, audit-ready case notes and rationale logs in internal case management systems to satisfy QA benchmarks and internal compliance audits.

• Workflow Feedback: Identify recurring friction points, false-positive trends, and operational bottlenecks within EDD workflows, providing actionable data to Senior Analysts to help refine templates and SOPs.

Required Qualifications and Key Competencies

• Experience: 1-3 years of direct operational experience in AML/KYC, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), financial crime investigations, or fraud operations within fintech, digital brokerage, or a regulated financial institution.

• IDV & Risk Tool Fluency: Working knowledge of modern identity verification platforms (e.g., Persona, Jumio, Veriff, Onfido) and screening databases (e.g., LexisNexis, World-Check, ComplyAdvantage).

• Investigative Rationale & Writing: Strong written communication skills, with a track record of authoring concise, objective, and defensible case narratives.

• Adherence to Established Frameworks: High operational discipline and sound judgment to evaluate qualitative risk signals within structured SOPs, knowing precisely when and how to escalate edge cases.

• Attention to Detail: Acute visual and analytical attention to detail to spot minor indicators of document alteration, metadata inconsistencies, and synthetic identity markers.

• Asynchronous Collaboration: Ability to manage high-priority investigation queues independently and partner cross-functionally across remote compliance, legal, and operational teams.

• Clear Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to accurately document case notes, clearly summarize issues for escalation, and collaborate effectively within a remote team environment.

Company Culture & Perks

About the Company

Founded in Sydney in 2007, IC is a global trading brand built around precision and performance. We combine advanced trading technology with deep liquidity, low-latency connectivity and infrastructure designed for traders. Everything is built around execution, control and the needs of traders who treat trading as a craft.

The same standards shape how we work. Precision. Performance. Transparency. Respect. We value people who know their craft, take ownership and hold themselves to high standards. As IC grows globally, we are building teams that move with purpose and focus on what matters.

About the Job

We are looking for a Salesforce Developer who approaches Salesforce development through the lens of modern software engineering. At IC, Salesforce is where our sales, retention, partner and support teams work every day. We maintain a modular DX codebase, enforce clean object-oriented design patterns, build Lightning Web Components to a consistent design system, and follow strict code-quality and testing practices. If you enjoy writing clean, decoupled Apex, designing reactive and localised LWC frontends, and working in a modern Git and scratch-org workflow without legacy clutter, we’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll own

• Turn requirements into technical designs, then deliver Apex and Lightning Web Components for our support, sales, KYC, trading account, payment and partner workflows.

• Work with our trigger framework and Unit of Work, query builder, collection utilities, async actions and batch frameworks.

• Build reusable Lightning Web Components to our design system, with a custom label for every string and locale-aware formatting.

• Build and maintain REST integrations with payload validation, resilient error handling and mockable tests.

• Write bulkified, governor-aware code and async pipelines, and resolve performance bottlenecks and technical debt.

• Implement permission set groups, custom permissions, sharing and field-level security for every new feature.

• Write deterministic tests that check behaviour, not just coverage.

• Release through scratch orgs, pull requests and automated validation, from stage to UAT to production.

• Own features from design to production, delivering scalable, well-documented code to our engineering standards.

What you’ll need

Essential

• 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development in an enterprise org.

• Strong Apex: triggers, Queueable, Batch and Scheduled jobs, bulkification and governor limits.

• Strong LWC and modern JavaScript (ES6+): lifecycle hooks, reactivity and component composition.

• Object-oriented design: SOLID principles and common design patterns.

• REST integrations: outbound callouts, inbound Apex REST, JSON, and Named and External Credentials.

• Solid SOQL skills: selective queries, indexing and safe dynamic query generation for large data volumes.

• Salesforce DX, sf CLI, Git, GitHub and a pull-request workflow.

• Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.

Your approach

• You read existing code before adding to it, and your changes look like they belong.

• You ask what problem a ticket solves before you estimate it, and flag gaps in a requirement early.

• You support your features after release and fix your own bugs first.

• You communicate clearly with developers, BAs and QA, including colleagues in other time zones.

• You’re keen to learn the trading domain: accounts, IBs, KYC and multi-entity regulation.

Desirable

• Salesforce Platform Developer II, or a Sales/Service Cloud Consultant certification

• Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, or GitHub Copilot) for code generation, Apex/LWC refactoring, test class generation, and rapid debugging.

• Unlocked packages and package-based development

• Event-driven design with Platform Events

• Service Cloud experience, including CTI and call-centre integrations

• Brokerage or fintech experience: KYC/AML, MT4, MT5 or cTrader, IB models

Job TitleSenior Product Manager - OTC Trading

Job Description
Location: London, UK (Hybrid: 3 days in office)
Employment type: Permanent, full time

So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.

The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.

Join us at IG – the future gets built here.

Your Team:
This role sits within the Trading & Investments domain of the Product function, reporting into the Head of Product, Trading & Investments. The domain’s mission is to give every client the tools to trade, from first investment to multi-asset portfolio. You will use AI tools and work closely with engineering, design, dealing, compliance, legal, and marketing to define and deliver the OTC trading proposition and help expand it to other markets. The team operates at the intersection of product craft and commercial ambition, focused on building trading experiences that feel effortless for IG’s customers while keeping them safe, informed and in control.

Your role in the Team’s Success:
This is a role for a Senior PM who is as comfortable defining the strategy as they are shipping against it. As Senior Product Manager for OTC Trading, you will own the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for IG’s leveraged derivatives offering: spread bets, CFDs, options and futures. You will determine which problems are worth solving, set direction, and drive execution end to end. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, navigate ambiguity, and make decisions that directly shape commercial outcomes. You will not be handed a brief. You will write it.

IG is moving towards a single, modern trading platform across its markets. This is a chance to shape what OTC trading looks like on that platform: rapid, reliable, secure and intuitive, for clients ranging from first-time derivatives traders to experienced professionals.

What you’ll do:
Product strategy and roadmap
• Own the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for OTC trading, aligned to IG’s commercial objectives. You will set that roadmap, not just contribute to it.
• Determine which problems are worth solving and why, before any solution work begins.
• Make strategic build vs buy vs partner decisions grounded in customer needs, commercial viability, and technical feasibility.
• Drive competitive intelligence and translate market insights into differentiated propositions across spread betting, CFDs, options and futures.
• Shape how the OTC proposition converges onto a single global platform, balancing local market needs with a consistent client experience.

Discovery and delivery
• Run discovery that goes beyond what customers say. Understand the motivations, friction points, and habits that drive or block trading behaviour.
• Use AI tools actively across your workflow: synthesising research, generating prototypes, accelerating delivery, and surfacing insights faster.
• Partner with engineering and design to scope, prioritise, and ship with quality and pace.
• Define success metrics and iterate relentlessly based on evidence.

Cross-functional leadership
• Influence stakeholders across product, engineering, dealing, legal, compliance, marketing, and senior leadership. You drive alignment up, down, and across the organisation.
• Work closely with Peer Product Managers leading the adjacent areas, as well as coordinate with teams across Core technology to help build scalable backend systems.
• Navigate regulatory requirements (including product governance and Consumer Duty) and translate compliance constraints into seamless customer experiences, including how risk, margin and leverage are presented to clients.
• Work comfortably with APIs, pricing and execution infrastructure, and platform integrations.
• Identify opportunities to optimise and present pricing it in ways that helps customers and business.
• Mentor and raise the bar for PMs around you.

What You'll Need:

• Five or more years shipping consumer-facing products in trading platforms, investment platforms, neobanks, fintech, or adjacent consumer financial services.
• Proven ability to own and drive product strategy. That means vision setting and direction, not just roadmap input.
• Deep curiosity about trader and investor behaviour. You understand what makes people start trading, stop, switch, or stay.
• AI-native working style: you already use AI tools (LLMs, prototyping tools, research synthesis, workflow automation) to move faster and think better.
• Comfortable with ambiguity. You can define the problem when the brief doesn’t exist yet.
• Obsession with customer experience. You sweat the details that make journeys feel effortless, including in complex, real-time trading interfaces.
• Regulatory intuition. You can navigate compliance without it becoming a blocker to great UX, and you are comfortable working in a heavily regulated, risk-sensitive product area.
• Evidence and data-driven. You define metrics, run experiments, and make calls based on what works.
• Strong stakeholder management. You influence without authority and drive alignment across complex organisations.

Desirable
• Direct experience with leveraged or derivative products (CFDs, spread betting, options, futures, FX) or active trading platforms.
• Experience building or launching AI-powered features in a consumer product.
• Worked on platform partnerships, broker integrations, or exchange infrastructure.
• Built products that serve both novice investors and sophisticated traders.
• Experience in fintech, financial services, or a similarly regulated industry.
• Exposure to multi-market or multi-regulator product environments.

The perks
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office.
